title: Stellaris: Willpower

about:
Give the Galaxy Something to Believe In

In the vast expanse of the cosmos, borders are mere lines drawn on a map. Ideas, on the other hand, have no such limits.

Your empire was founded on its Ethics. In Stellaris: Willpower, those values evolve into Ideologies with the power to sway the stars, turning your beliefs into a galactic force.

Your Ideology can rally entire civilizations, but it can also turn inward. If your authority weakens, colonies may radicalize and rise against you.

The galaxy is ready to believe. What will you teach?

IDEOLOGIES

An Ethic backed with fanatic conviction can become an Ideology that crosses borders. Once you establish your Ideology, you can start spreading it across neighboring systems using Starbases, Hyper Relays, and Ideological Beacons into other Empires.

Foreign populations may adopt your values, forming Fanatic Factions corroding your enemies from within.

However, staying true to your values becomes critical as you spread your Tenets across the Galaxy. Without an eye for your Momentum, internal factions might start revolting as they demand you stay true to your values.

GALACTIC HALLS

A relocatable Galactic Hall gives your Ideology a visible place on the galactic map. Above a colony, it strengthens local output and Ideological Reach. At the frontier, it carries your message into contested space.

Galactic Halls come with a design for every Ethic (yes, there is a biological one too!).

NEW AMBITION: FORCE OF WILL

Who says winning the galaxy requires conquering it?

Discover a different route to victory: make the Galaxy follow you, and defeat all the Fallen Empires. 

Convert populations, draw other empires into your orbit, and sustain the Momentum that fuels your Willpower. As your Ideology spreads across the Galaxy, prove that yours are the ideas that will save everyone from the threats of the Fallen Empires.

IDEOLOGICAL DIPLOMACY

Ideological power extends into diplomacy. Empires can adopt your doctrine, and Federation laws can establish an official belief for the alliance. The same struggle reaches the Galactic Community, where you can denounce rival doctrine.

Espionage Operations can manipulate Ideological Reach, sow doubt, and incite revolt where your beliefs have already taken hold. If covert pressure fails, a new Casus Belli will allow you to impose your Ideology through war. It is still persuasion, only with more battleships.

THREE NEW ORIGINS

Golden Generation: Educate a cohort of promising students at the Golden Academy, then recruit them as the next generation of leaders.

Lost Makers: A Machine Intelligence searches the stars for its creators, whose story is tied to one of the galaxy's existing Precursors.

Great Mosaic: Begin with an additional Civic and no prescribed narrative path. Shape the empire you want from the very beginning.

AND MORE!

Five new Fanatic Civics.

More than 40 events follow Ideologies as they rise, clash, and fracture.

8 Ideological Paragons embodying the major Fanatic Ethics. 

Ideological Buildings.

Inquisitor shipset and city set.

A new advisor.
